shadowbox.purpose: Reproduce the deterministic timezone-dependent test failure from demo-app/

bug.description: Uses local-timezone Date methods (getDate, getMonth, getFullYear) instead of UTC equivalents to extract a calendar date from a UTC ISO timestamp.
bug.trigger: TZ environment variable is not set to the developer's local timezone (Asia/Calcutta / IST / UTC+5:30)

failingTests: isDueToday() > returns true for an invoice whose UTC time crosses midnight into the target date in local TZ
getInvoicesDueOn() > returns both invoices due on 2024-01-15 (local TZ)
getInvoicesDueOn() > returns correct total amount for due invoices
